caption.text: Part 2 of THE JAVASCRIPT EVENT LOOP. Your setTimeout(fn, 0) is a lie — it is a minimum delay, clamped to 4ms, queued behind every microtask your promises just spawned. This handbook is 10 pages of the real machinery: the empty-stack rule, the drain, the frame pipeline, Node's phases, and the two ways an event loop dies (blocking and starvation). Work the drills; if you can order sync, await, queueMicrotask and setTimeout in one snippet, you actually know the loop.
